_comment: Step 13: the AI budget guard (job/guard.py and worker/src/guard.js, kept identical by tests/fixtures/guard_cases.json). Calls are counted per model since midnight Pacific time (when Gemini's free day resets). Level 1 delays new custom-topic checks; level 2 also delays translations (stories wait, Step 10 rule). Pass 1 and the editor never wait. The soft limits are ours, below Google's real daily caps (which the API does not show); raise or lower them here. Step 20: 'chain' is the order of free providers, 'emergency' the paid key's hard caps and prices (job/ai.py, worker/src/spend.js).

chain._comment: Step 20. Pass 1, the editor and keywords: each free Gemini model on its own (its own quota and its own 503s), then Groq's models in rotation (each its own per-minute limit), then the emergency key. Translations: only the strong models, never Groq. A free Gemini 503 is retried after these waits while the run's retry time lasts.

emergency._comment: Step 20. GEMINI_EMERGENCY_API_KEY: a separate AI Studio project with $10 of Prepay credits (bought 2026-11-23, they expire after 12 months; auto-reload off; Google's own monthly cap $2, which can lag about 10 minutes). Used ONLY when every free option failed for that call. Hard caps in code, per UTC day and month, checked BEFORE a call against its worst case (prompt tokens plus max_output_tokens at the price). Cheapest model that passes our checks: 3.1 Flash-Lite for pass 1, the editor and topic checks; translations need a strong model.
